caption_used: Negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens between baseline MistralV0.2-Base and the same model further fine-tuned on each specialty data. The chart displays six specialty groups along the x-axis (Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, Pediatrics), with the y-axis showing negative log probability ranging from approximately -27 to -22. Within each group, the MistralV0.2-Base bar (light blue) consistently shows the highest negative log probability, indicating weaker token predictions at baseline. Among the fine-tuned models, the Gastro-tuned variant achieves the lowest negative log probability across most specialty groups, suggesting strong cross-specialty transfer. Notably, the Infect group shows the largest overall bar heights, with baseline reaching approximately -23.5, while the Cardio group exhibits the smallest spread between baseline and fine-tuned variants at roughly 1.5 units.
raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The figure is a grouped vertical bar chart illustrating negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens, comparing a baseline model (MistralV0.2-Base) against versions fine-tuned on different clinical specialties. The horizontal axis is labeled “Per-specialty terms” and lists six category groups from left to right: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical axis is labeled “Negative log probability” and uses a linear numeric scale with tick labels shown at approximately −27, −26, −25, −24, −23, and −22 (range roughly −27 to −22). Each category group contains seven adjacent bars: one light-blue bar for “MistralV0.2-Base,” followed by six fine-tuned bars in progressively darker warm tones (light beige to dark brown) corresponding to the legend “Fine-tuned on: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, Pediatrics.” Approximate bar values by group are: Cardio has a baseline near −26.7 and fine-tuned bars clustered around roughly −25.7 to −26.1; Gastro has a baseline near −24.8 with fine-tuned bars around about −23.8 to −24.2; Infect has a baseline near −23.7 with fine-tuned bars around about −22.9 to −23.3; Neuro has a baseline near −25.4 with fine-tuned bars around about −24.1 to −24.7; Obstetrics has a baseline near −24.7 with fine-tuned bars around about −23.7 to −24.1; Pediatrics has a baseline near −24.7 with fine-tuned bars around about −23.5 to −24.0. The bars are not presented as a sorted ranking; instead, they are consistently arranged within each group by the legend order, with no additional annotations or emphasized bars beyond the color coding.
